name: Hand-written scanner
description: Character-at-a-time scanner with maximal munch (--lexer=handwritten).

name: Preprocessor subset
description: Object-like #define, #undef, #ifdef/#ifndef/#if/#elif/#else/#endif on integers and defined().

name: re2c direct-coded DFA scanner
description: The default lexer: generated by re2c 4.6, token-for-token identical to the hand-written one.

name: Recursive descent with Pratt expressions
description: Hand-written parser producing the typed AST.

name: Panic-mode error recovery
description: Resynchronizes at statement boundaries: one diagnostic per fault.

name: Bison IELR(1) parser
description: Generated by Bison 3.8 (--parser=bison); the same AST, different error recovery, so not the default.

name: Type checking and C integer conversions
description: Scoped symbol table, integer promotions and usual arithmetic conversions (LP64).

name: printf/scanf format checking
description: Checks format strings against their argument types.

name: Typed three-address code
description: Quadruples carrying the C integer type they compute in.

name: IR verifier
description: Block shape, branch targets, edge consistency, use-before-def, and SSA dominance.

name: SSA construction and destruction
description: Cytron et al. phi placement and renaming; Sreedhar copies plus coalescing on the way out.

name: Basic blocks and control-flow graph
description: Leader algorithm with a synthetic entry block.

name: Reaching definitions
description: Forward, union; on the generic monotone solver.

name: Available expressions
description: Forward, intersection.

name: Live variables
description: Backward, union.

name: Dominators and natural loops
description: Iterative dominator sets, immediate-dominator tree, back edges, natural loops.

name: Basic alias analysis
description: Distinct allocations never alias; unknown pointers may alias anything; calls clobber memory.

name: Analysis manager
description: Caches analyses between passes; dropped when a pass changes the IR.

name: P1 constant folding
description: Evaluates operations on constants.

name: P2 constant propagation
description: Replaces a use with a constant when that is its only reaching definition.

name: P3 copy propagation
description: Replaces a use with the source of a same-block copy.

name: P4 common subexpression elimination
description: Reuses a same-block recomputation.

name: P5 dead-code elimination
description: Deletes a pure computation whose result is never live.

name: P6 unreachable-code elimination
description: Folds constant branches and deletes unreachable blocks.

name: P7 strength reduction
description: Replaces i*K in a loop with an incrementally maintained variable.

name: P8 loop-invariant code motion
description: Hoists pure invariant computations to the preheader.

name: P9 jump peephole
description: Collapses jump chains and drops gotos to the next block.

name: Sparse conditional constant propagation
description: Wegman-Zadeck; subsumes P1, P2 and P6.

name: Global value numbering
description: Dominator-tree scoped value numbering; removes cross-block redundancy.

name: Loop-invariant code motion on SSA
description: Hoists invariant computations and loads no store or call in the loop can change.

name: Mark-sweep dead-code elimination
description: Keeps only what effects transitively use; removes dead cycles.

name: Function inlining
description: Not implemented.

name: Loop unrolling
description: Not implemented.

name: Vectorization
description: Needs a machine target; Cppify has none.

name: Quad interpreter
description: Executes the IR directly; runs the program unoptimized and optimized.

name: AST reference interpreter
description: Runs the typed AST with no IR (--run-ast), so an IRGen bug cannot pass by agreeing with itself.

name: Register bytecode VM
description: Compiles IR to registers and resolved jumps, switch dispatch (--run-vm); about 4x the quad interpreter's speed on bench/programs.

name: Differential execution
description: Unoptimized and optimized runs must print the same bytes.

name: Clang oracle
description: Every test program must behave as it does when built by clang.
